goal: Making the verdict record the acceptance traded a test gate for a signature: an agent could close a verification task by typing any string as evidence, and nobody would know until review. Require the evidence to name something real - a path that exists, or an identifier that appears in the checkout, excluding the verdict records themselves and the checker (a self-test names the string it tests). Update the 30 tasks' goals to say what evidence must be, and pin the fabricated case in --self-test. Evidence must name something real: a path that exists in the checkout, or an identifier (a test name) that appears in it. The checker verifies this, so a verdict cannot be closed by typing a claim.
title: A delivered verdict must name evidence that exists
